item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a continental airstream, it will be generally fine and dry over southern China early to midweek next week. The temperature difference over inland areas between day and night will be relatively large.
